title: Ionic bonding in sodium chloride
caption: Sodium's single outer electron (cross) transfers to chlorine, which has seven (dots). Both ions end with full outer shells: Na⁺ (2, 8) and Cl⁻ (2, 8, 8). Only the outer shells are drawn.
alt: Dot-and-cross diagram: a sodium atom with one outer electron and a chlorine atom with seven, then the ions in brackets: Na⁺ with an empty outer shell, Cl⁻ with eight outer electrons, one of them a cross.
description: Before: Na with one cross in its outer shell; Cl with seven dots.
After: [Na]⁺ with no outer electrons shown, and [Cl]⁻ with eight, seven dots and one cross.
